lineage.core_design: aviary procedure chronology and age-bound entry exceptions

chapters.title: Dawn procedure card
chapters.body: The printed dawn procedure schedules seed mist before the first wing count in Starling Vault.

chapters.title: Alarm-day execution log
chapters.body: On alarm day Elian Moss completed the first wing count, then released seed mist afterward because the reservoir seal was checked late.

chapters.title: Copper tag rule
chapters.body: The aviary rule requires every glasswing bird to wear a copper ankle tag before ordinary roost entry.

chapters.title: Hatchling exception
chapters.body: A quarantine exception permits glasswing fledglings younger than three days to enter Indigo Roost untagged through the nursery hatch.

chapters.title: Vault temperature
chapters.body: Pera Dune logged Starling Vault at eighteen degrees Celsius throughout the quiet watch.

chapters.title: Keeper notebook
chapters.body: Pera Dune records feeding totals in a black linen notebook kept beneath the eastern perch.

chapters.title: Blue feather intake bundle
chapters.body: One unsigned intake label calls the blue feather an Indigo Gull feather and another calls it Sky Tern; neither label has a custody signature, and the ledger declares no source-priority rule.

chapters.title: Incubator readiness sheet
chapters.body: Incubator bay four logged heat, humidity, and the required turning cycle, but the final dawn-count result cell is blank and no hatch observation was recorded.

memory.subject: untagged hatchling entry
memory.value: glasswing fledglings younger than three days
